about: Latest live state of the Canary Wharf / Docklands zone and the last 24 hours, written by cwplans/tools/cache-londat.mjs (danbri/londat) from the history in this folder. Times: ISO UTC. Each theme keeps the licence of its source (sources).
history: cache/runs/2026-11-DD/live-*.json.gz (this month, one file per run); cache/live-YYYY-MM.sqlite (closed months)

rows: Central Line: Minor delays between Leytonstone and Epping while we fix a faulty track at South Woodford. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of line.

Metropolitan Line: Minor delays between Moor Park and Amersham due to train cancellations. After the 13:48 departure from Amersham, the next southbound train will be at 14:48. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line.
Northern Line: Severe delays due to an earlier customer incident.Tickets being accepted by London Buses.
Piccadilly Line: Minor delays between Acton Town and Heathrow Terminals due to an earlier customer incident at South Kensington. GODO SERVICE on the rest of the line.
